# cycle_stacks (Data Source)

Lists all Cycle stacks in the hub.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every stack in the hub.
data "cycle_stacks" "all" {}

output "stack_names" {
  value = [for s in data.cycle_stacks.all.stacks : s.name]
}

output "live_stack_ids" {
  value = [
    for s in data.cycle_stacks.all.stacks : s.id
    if s.state == "live"
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `stacks` (Attributes List) All stacks in the hub. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stacks))

<a id="nestedatt--stacks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks`

Read-Only:

- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this stack belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the stack.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slugged identifier of the stack.
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the stack.
- `source` (Attributes) The stack source. Exactly one of `git_repo` or `raw` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stacks--source))
- `state` (String) The current state of the stack.
- `variables` (Map of String) Default variable values configured on the stack.

<a id="nestedatt--stacks--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.source`

Read-Only:

- `git_repo` (Attributes) Source the stack from a git repository containing a stack spec file (defaults to `cycle.json` at the repo root). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stacks--source--git_repo))
- `raw` (String) An inline Cycle stack spec as normalized JSON. Unmarshaled into a `StackSpec` (`version`, `containers`, optional `about`, and so on).

<a id="nestedatt--stacks--source--git_repo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.source.git_repo`

Read-Only:

- `auth` (Attributes) Authentication for a private repository. Exactly one of `http` (user/token) or `ssh` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stacks--source--git_repo--auth))
- `branch` (String) The branch to use. Defaults to `master` on the platform when omitted.
- `ref_type` (String) The type of git reference to pin (for example `branch`, `tag`, or `commit`). Must be set together with `ref_value`.
- `ref_value` (String) The value of the git reference identified by `ref_type`. Must be set together with `ref_type`.
- `stack_file` (String) Path to the stack spec file in the repository. Defaults to `cycle.json` at the repo root.
- `url` (String) The URL of the git repository.

<a id="nestedatt--stacks--source--git_repo--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.source.git_repo.auth`

Read-Only:

- `http` (Attributes) HTTP user/token credentials. The token is sent to the Cycle API as the HTTP password. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stacks--source--git_repo--auth--http))
- `ssh` (Attributes) SSH key credentials for the repository. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stacks--source--git_repo--auth--ssh))

<a id="nestedatt--stacks--source--git_repo--auth--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.source.git_repo.auth.http`

Read-Only:

- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token (or password) used for HTTP authentication.
- `username` (String) The username used for HTTP authentication.


<a id="nestedatt--stacks--source--git_repo--auth--ssh"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stacks.source.git_repo.auth.ssh`

Read-Only:

- `passphrase` (String, Sensitive) The passphrase for the private key, if any.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) A PEM-encoded private key.
- `username` (String) The username used to authenticate the SSH key.
